grind_pressure.0: Minimal/none: ordinary main-story progress does not materially require repeat combat/resource loops; catch-up, generous EXP, level scaling, or equivalent QoL may make incidental battles sufficient.
grind_pressure.1: Low: occasional repeat combat/resource acquisition may help, but the main path normally advances without deliberate extended farming.
grind_pressure.2: Moderate: repeated combat/economy/material loops are periodically useful or required to smooth progression, but do not dominate the experience.
grind_pressure.3: High: deliberate repeated combat/resource loops are materially required for multiple progression gates or consume a substantial share of play time.
grind_pressure.4: Severe: long repetitive farming/level/economy loops are a central progression requirement and dominate substantial portions of the main path.

context_rule: A grind or hours label is never universal without its difficulty, speed-up, cheat/debug and completion context. Distinct materially different contexts should be separate label records, not averaged into one fact.
readiness_note: These are minimum policy gates for allowing a calibration experiment to start, not a claim of statistical adequacy or production accuracy. Cross-validation and error analysis remain mandatory after the gate opens.
